test_lasso_guard_config: test the lasso guardrail configuration with a valid API key and pre_call mode
test_lasso_guard_config_no_api_key: test that init_guardrails_v2 raises LassoGuardrailMissingSecrets when the LASSO_API_KEY env var is missing
test_callback: test the lasso guardrail async_pre_call_hook detects jailbreak violations and raises HTTPException
test_empty_messages: test the lasso guardrail returns data unchanged when the messages list is empty
test_api_error_handling: test that LassoGuardrailAPIError is raised when the lasso API connection fails or times out
